decisions.decision: Mr. Ebersole rescinded his earlier motion to ratify the Town Manager's appointments (except the Animal Control Officer), and Mr. Toale withdrew his second.
decisions.quote: after due and diligent discussion, mr. ebersole rescinded his previous motion.

decisions.decision: Action on the Town Manager's appointments was to be deferred to the 7/8/2014 BOS meeting; the minutes record that no vote was taken on that motion.
decisions.quote: no vote was taken by the board on mr. ebersole's motion.

decisions.decision: Board asked the Town Manager to clarify the duties of the Field Driver and Technical Advisory Committee, and who the appointing authority is for the Inspector of Animals.
decisions.quote: the bos would like the town manager to clarify the duties of the field driver, technical advisory committee

decisions.decision: Mr. Ebersole requested that the Town Manager implement the re-appointment form for many of the positions.
decisions.quote: mr. ebersole requested that the town manager implement the re-appointment form for many of these positions

decisions.decision: The Animal Control Officer is to be given the opportunity to come before the BOS before any non-ratification.
decisions.quote: ms. bertram suggested that the animal control officer be given the opportunity to come before the bos

decisions.decision: Town Manager said she would like to put the appointment of the Animal Control Officer under the Police Dept. and review that personnel matter before meeting with the person.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel mentioned that she would like to put the appointment of the animal control officer under the police dept.

decisions.decision: Incumbents whose terms ended 6/30/2014 may remain in position for 15 days after that date, and indefinitely if reappointments are not made by then.
decisions.quote: all incumbents will be able to remain in their positions for 15 days after 6/30/2014

decisions.decision: BOS will interview potential candidates in July, aiming to fill the vacancies in August.
decisions.quote: bos will conduct interviews of potential candidates in the month of july with the goal of filling the vacancies in august.

decisions.decision: Mr. Alonzo recommended that the first interviews be scheduled for the PACC, Personnel Committee, and the COA.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo recommended that the interviews that would be scheduled first would be for the pacc, personnel committee, and the coa.
